preview: Value of the Data•These data provide information on the antimicrobial peptides that have antimicrobial activity directly on the pathogen, among innate immunity, an important immune system of rock bream.•These data provide the expression patterns of RbLEAP-2 for immune responses in rock bream infected with various pathogens, and will be fundamental to improving the understanding of the role of RbLEAP-2.•Based on these tissue-specific expression data sets, further studies on related genes will contribute to gaining insights into the limited functions of LEAP-2 in teleost.•The antimicrobial activity data can be an important basic data for developing new antimicrobial products.
